_doc: One row per agent browser on the shared Mac. port = its CDP port (unique, 9222–9299) · profile = its own Chrome user-data-dir (no spaces) · color = #RRGGBB (the theme's frame) · label = the name written on the frame. Optional: state, log, launcher (+ launcherEnv), managedBy (another program owns it — report only), idleMinutes (its reaper may idle-stop it), noTheme.
